daily.title: Après l’attentat de Cracovie, la Pologne en état de choc
daily.summary: Six personnes ont été tuées et quinze autres ont été blessées, samedi, dans le centre historique de Cracovie, par un Polonais de 24 ans « fasciné par l’extrême droite », selon les termes du ministre de l’intérieur. Le parquet a ouvert dimanche une enquête pour acte à « caractère terroriste ».

daily.title: 2026 Dakar Youth Olympic Games: Golden Double for Senegal
daily.summary: Senegal won two gold medals in beach wrestling at the Youth Olympic Games in Dakar. Elisabeth Diatta won gold in the -55 kg category, the host country’s first gold medal at the Youth Olympic Games. Her compatriot Maguette Diop followed suit, taking gold in the -80 kg category.

daily.summary: Diwali celebrations began on Sunday, with people across India and the global diaspora gathering to mark one of the most important festivals in the Hindu tradition. daily.title: Paraguay: Senate impeached Peña rather than accept his offer to resign
daily.summary: Paraguay's ousted president, Santiago Peña, has been charged over the collapse of Ueno Bank. Initially placed under house arrest, he has since been transferred to a military facility for his own safety. Nearly three million customers were locked out of their accounts after regulators seized control of the online bank.

daily.title: Léon XIV attendu en Argentine, un pays où l’Eglise se positionne aux antipodes du projet de société de Javier Milei

Leur fondateur, un Catalan de 24 ans, prépare le lancement d’une application de rencontres communautaires.

daily.summary: US President Donald Trump on Saturday said he was asking mixed martial arts promoter Dana White to be the new White House press secretary. Trump has repeatedly tried to hitch his MAGA brand of politics to White's enormously successful Ultimate Fighting Championship.

daily.title: Israeli president picks Netanyahu's rival Eisenkot to try to form government
daily.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog picked former military chief Gadi Eisenkot to try to form a government, he said in a statement Saturday. Last month's parliamentary elections left neither Eisenkot nor Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu with a clear path to building a majority.

daily.title: France investigating if bogus bomb threats against airlines linked to 'foreign powers'
daily.summary: French prosecutors are investigating a series of fake bomb threats that targeted commercial flights in Europe this week, including trying to establish whether foreign powers may be involved. Those responsible for the bogus threats have not been identified.

daily.title: Paraguay’s impeached president charged over business links to bank collapse
daily.summary: Paraguay’s impeached president Santiago Peña was on Saturday charged over his business links to a major online bank whose sudden collapse locked millions of people out of their money and sparked angry protests.

daily.title: Gunman who killed at least six in Krakow ‘fascinated’ by far-right ideologies, government says
daily.summary: A gunman reportedly "fascinated by far-right ideologies" shot and killed at least six people and wounded more than a dozen in Krakow’s main market square on Saturday, Polish authorities said. Three more bodies were later found at the home of the gunman, who was wounded and taken into custody.

daily.title: Pope Leo calls on Uruguay's Catholics to be 'bridge builders'
daily.summary: Pope Leo XIV urged Catholics in Uruguay to build bridges of faith and fraternity on the second day of his 12-day tour of Uruguay, Argentina and Peru. The pope's three-country tour comes just three weeks after he underwent surgery for lung cancer.
